Theorem
[Ricci Identities] 1. ch7:7.14

On a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold, the following identities hold. For a vector field $Z$, \[ abla ^2_{X,Y}Z- abla ^2_{Y,X}Z=R(X,Y)Z. \qquad (7.17) \] For a $1$-form $ eta $, \[ abla ^2_{X,Y} eta - abla ^2_{Y,X} eta =-R(X,Y)^* eta . \qquad (7.18) \] For a $(k,l)$-tensor field $B$, egin{align} & ( abla ^2_{X,Y}B- abla ^2_{Y,X}B) (\omega ^1,\ldots ,\omega ^k,V_1,\ldots ,V_l) otag \ & \quad =\sum _{a=1}^k B(\omega ^1,\ldots ,R(X,Y)^*\omega ^a,\ldots ,\omega ^k, V_1,\ldots ,V_l) otag \ & \qquad -\sum _{b=1}^l B(\omega ^1,\ldots ,\omega ^k, V_1,\ldots ,R(X,Y)V_b,\ldots ,V_l). ag {7.19} \end{align} In every local frame, these become egin{equation} Z^i_{;pq}-Z^i_{;qp}=-R_{pqm}^iZ^m, ag {7.20} \end{equation} egin{equation} eta _{j;pq}- eta _{j;qp}=R_{pqj}^m eta _m, ag {7.21} \end{equation} and egin{align} B^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l;pq} -B^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l;qp} & =-R_{pqm}^{i_1}B^{m i_2\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_l} -\cdots -R_{pqm}^{i_k}B^{i_1\cdots i_{k-1}m}_{j_1\cdots j_l} otag \ & \quad +R_{pqj_1}^mB^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{m j_2\cdots j_l} +\cdots +R_{pqj_l}^mB^{i_1\cdots i_k}_{j_1\cdots j_{l-1}m}. ag {7.22} \end{align}

Proof

\sketch Symmetry of the connection and the formula for second total covariant derivatives give, for every tensor field $B$,

egin{align} abla ^2_{X,Y}B- abla ^2_{Y,X}B & = abla _X abla _YB- abla _Y abla _XB- abla _{[X,Y]}B. ag {7.23} \end{align}

For $B=Z$, this is the definition of $R(X,Y)Z$, proving (7.17).

For a $1$-form $ eta $, repeated use of the covector derivative rule gives

egin{align} ( abla _X abla _Y eta )(Z) & =XY( eta (Z))-( abla _X eta )( abla _YZ) - eta ( abla _X abla _YZ) -( abla _Y eta )( abla _XZ), ag {7.24}\ ( abla _Y abla _X eta )(Z) & =YX( eta (Z))-( abla _Y eta )( abla _XZ) - eta ( abla _Y abla _XZ) -( abla _X eta )( abla _YZ), ag {7.25}\ ( abla _{[X,Y]} eta )(Z) & =[X,Y]( eta (Z))- eta ( abla _{[X,Y]}Z). ag {7.26} \end{align}

Substituting these into (7.23) leaves $- eta (R(X,Y)Z)$, proving (7.18).

The operator in (7.23) is a derivation for tensor products:

egin{align*} ( abla ^2_{X,Y}- abla ^2_{Y,X})(F\otimes G) & =( abla ^2_{X,Y}F- abla ^2_{Y,X}F)\otimes G\ & \quad +F\otimes ( abla ^2_{X,Y}G- abla ^2_{Y,X}G). \end{align*}

Applying this identity to decomposable tensors and using (7.17)–(7.18) proves (7.19). For a local frame $(E_j)$ with dual coframe $(e^i)$, evaluate at $(e^{i_1},\ldots ,e^{i_k},E_{j_1},\ldots ,E_{j_l})$ and use

\[ R(E_q,E_p)E_j=-R_{pqj}^mE_m,\qquad R(E_q,E_p)^*e^i=-R_{pqm}^ie^m \]

to obtain (7.22); (7.20) and (7.21) are its special cases.
